A set of mechanical pre-checks has ALREADY been run and their results are given to you verbatim; treat them as ground truth, do not attempt to re-derive them yourself.

# Deterministic Pre-Checks (already run — use as input, do not re-derive)

- parent_contract: pass

# Output Instruction
Respond with a SINGLE JSON object and nothing else — no prose before or after it, no markdown fence required (but allowed). The object MUST match this shape exactly:
{
  "decision": "approve" | "reject" | "escalate",
  "confidence": <number 0-1>,
  "reasons": [
    { "dimension": "<e.g. completeness, consistency, contract>", "finding": "<what you found>",
      "evidence_ref": "<optional pointer>" }
  ],
  "blocking_questions": ["<string>", ...]
}
RULES:
- decision "escalate" REQUIRES at least one entry in blocking_questions.
- Every OTHER decision REQUIRES blocking_questions to be an EMPTY array.
- Prefer "escalate" over guessing when evidence is genuinely ambiguous or missing —
  a wrong confident answer is worse than an honest escalation.
- If ANY pre-check above has outcome "fail", you should almost always decision="reject"
  or "escalate", not "approve".
- reasons MUST have at least one entry.
